sources.title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation ...
sources.snippet: Figure 1: GCBT is a plug-and-play activation transform built on top of existing post-training quantizers in CFG-guided diffusion models. By applying a branch-wise rotation prior to quantization, it requires minimal modifications to model parameters or base pipelines.
